rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that a job or person is well-paid.

example.english: This job is well-paid and even comes with a double bonus.
example.traditional: 呢份工人工高，仲有雙糧。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 zung6 jau5 soeng1 loeng4

rows.note: Use this when focusing on how much the person earns rather than on the job's pay rate itself.

example.english: They are well-paid working as a real estate agent.
example.traditional: 佢做地產經紀真係搵得多。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 dei6 caan2 ging1 gei2 zan1 hai6 wan2 dak1 do1

rows.note: Use this mainly in job advertisements or formal descriptions for a position offering a high salary.

example.english: Our company is hiring well-paid engineers.
example.traditional: 本公司誠聘高薪工程師。
example.jyutping: bun2 gung1 si1 sing4 ping3 gou1 san1 gung1 cing4 si1
